translations.web: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,
translations.bsb: Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart:
translations.kjv: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;
